Let `K` be compact and let `f`, `g` be continuous on `K` and `C²` on `interior K`, with a
nonnegative coefficient `c` there. If `f` is a subsolution and `g` a supersolution of `-Δ + c`
(`c · f ≤ Δ f` and `Δ g ≤ c · g`) and `f ≤ g` on `frontier K`, then `f ≤ g` on all of `K`. This is
the two-function form of `le_of_mul_le_laplacian_le_frontier`.
decls.title: Comparison principle for `-Δ + c` with `c ≥ 0`
decls.statement:
theorem le_of_mul_le_laplacian_le_of_le_frontier {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {c f g : E → ℝ}
    (hfcont : ContinuousOn f K) (hgcont : ContinuousOn g K)
    (hfcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x)
    (hgcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x)
    (hc : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → 0 ≤ c x)
    (hsub : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → c x * f x ≤ Δ f x)
    (hsuper : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → Δ g x ≤ c x * g x)
    (hbdry : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ frontier K → f x ≤ g x) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ K → f x ≤ g x

decls.name: TauCeti.ge_of_laplacian_le_mul_ge_frontier
decls.doc:
**Weak minimum principle for supersolutions of `-Δ + c` with `c ≥ 0`.**

The dual of `le_of_mul_le_laplacian_le_frontier`: a continuous, `C²`, supersolution
(`Δ f x ≤ c x * f x`) with a nonnegative coefficient is bounded below on `K` by any **nonpositive**
lower bound it respects on `frontier K`.
decls.title: Weak minimum principle for supersolutions of `-Δ + c` with `c ≥ 0`
decls.statement:
theorem ge_of_laplacian_le_mul_ge_frontier {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {c f : E → ℝ} {m : ℝ}
    (hm : m ≤ 0) (hcont : ContinuousOn f K) (hcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x)
    (hc : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → 0 ≤ c x)
    (hsuper : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → Δ f x ≤ c x * f x)
    (hbdry : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ frontier K → m ≤ f x) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ K → m ≤ f x

decls.name: TauCeti.abs_le_of_laplacian_eq_mul_abs_le_frontier
decls.doc:
A solution of `-Δ u + c u = 0` (`Δ f = c · f`) with `c ≥ 0`, continuous on a compact set `K` and
`C²` on its interior, is bounded on `K` by any bound `M` its absolute value respects on
`frontier K`.
decls.statement:
theorem abs_le_of_laplacian_eq_mul_abs_le_frontier {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) {c f : E → ℝ}
    {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hcont : ContinuousOn f K)
    (hcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x)
    (hc : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → 0 ≤ c x)
    (hsol : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → Δ f x = c x * f x)
    (hbdry : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ frontier K → |f x| ≤ M) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ K → |f x| ≤ M

decls.name: TauCeti.eqOn_of_laplacian_sub_mul_eq_of_eqOn_frontier
decls.doc:
**Uniqueness for the Dirichlet problem for `-Δ + c` with `c ≥ 0`.**

If `f` and `g` are continuous on a compact set `K`, `C²` on `interior K` with the same source term
`Δ · - c · ·` there (so both solve `-Δ u + c u = h` for one `h`), and agree on `frontier K`, then
they agree on all of `K`.
decls.title: Uniqueness for the Dirichlet problem for `-Δ + c` with `c ≥ 0`
decls.statement:
theorem eqOn_of_laplacian_sub_mul_eq_of_eqOn_frontier {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K)
    {c f g : E → ℝ} (hfcont : ContinuousOn f K) (hgcont : ContinuousOn g K)
    (hfcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x)
    (hgcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x)
    (hc : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → 0 ≤ c x)
    (hlap : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → Δ f x - c x * f x = Δ g x - c x * g x)
    (hbdry : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ frontier K → f x = g x) :
    Set.EqOn f g K

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.solutionOfInner
decls.doc:
The solution supplied by Lax--Milgram for a represented forcing functional.

For `F : V`, `solutionOfInner hB F` is the unique vector `u` satisfying
`B u v = ⟪F, v⟫` for every `v`.
decls.statement: def solutionOfInner (hB : IsCoercive B) (F : V) : V

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.solutionOfInner_def
decls.doc: The represented-forcing solution is the inverse Lax--Milgram operator.
decls.statement:
theorem solutionOfInner_def (hB : IsCoercive B) (F : V) :
    solutionOfInner hB F = hB.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin.symm F

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin_solutionOfInner
decls.doc:
Applying the Lax--Milgram equivalence to the represented-forcing solution returns the
forcing vector.
decls.statement:
theorem continuousLinearEquivOfBilin_solutionOfInner (hB : IsCoercive B) (F : V) :
    hB.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin (solutionOfInner hB F) = F

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.solutionOfInner_continuousLinearEquivOfBilin
decls.doc:
Solving against the forcing represented by a Lax--Milgram image recovers the original
vector.
decls.statement:
theorem solutionOfInner_continuousLinearEquivOfBilin (hB : IsCoercive B) (u : V) :
    solutionOfInner hB (hB.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin u) = u

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.apply_solutionOfInner_eq_inner
decls.doc: The Lax--Milgram solution satisfies the variational equation.
decls.statement:
theorem apply_solutionOfInner_eq_inner (hB : IsCoercive B) (F v : V) :
    B (solutionOfInner hB F) v = ⟪F, v⟫_ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.eq_solutionOfInner
decls.doc: A vector satisfying the represented variational equation is the Lax--Milgram solution.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.existsUnique_forall_eq_inner
decls.doc:
Lax--Milgram as an existence-and-uniqueness theorem for represented functionals.

If `B` is coercive, then for every `F : V` there is a unique `u` such that
`B u v = ⟪F, v⟫` for all test vectors `v`.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_forall_eq_inner (hB : IsCoercive B) (F : V) :
    ∃! u : V, ∀ v : V, B u v = ⟪F, v⟫_ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.exists_forall_eq_inner
decls.doc: Lax--Milgram as an existence theorem for represented functionals.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_forall_eq_inner (hB : IsCoercive B) (F : V) :
    ∃ u : V, ∀ v : V, B u v = ⟪F, v⟫_ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.solutionOfFunctional
decls.doc:
The Lax--Milgram solution for an arbitrary continuous linear functional.

This is `solutionOfInner` applied to the Fréchet--Riesz representative of the functional.
decls.statement: def solutionOfFunctional (hB : IsCoercive B) (ℓ : StrongDual ℝ V) : V

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.solutionOfFunctional_def
decls.doc: The functional solution is obtained by solving against the Fréchet--Riesz representative.
decls.statement:
theorem solutionOfFunctional_def (hB : IsCoercive B) (ℓ : StrongDual ℝ V) :
    solutionOfFunctional hB ℓ =
      solutionOfInner hB ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ V).symm ℓ)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.solutionOfFunctional_toDual
decls.doc: For represented functionals, the functional solution agrees with `solutionOfInner`.
decls.statement:
theorem solutionOfFunctional_toDual (hB : IsCoercive B) (F : V) :
    solutionOfFunctional hB ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ V) F) = solutionOfInner hB F

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.apply_solutionOfFunctional_eq
decls.doc:
The Lax--Milgram solution for a continuous linear functional satisfies the variational
equation.
decls.statement:
theorem apply_solutionOfFunctional_eq (hB : IsCoercive B) (ℓ : StrongDual ℝ V) (v : V) :
    B (solutionOfFunctional hB ℓ) v = ℓ v

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.eq_solutionOfFunctional
decls.doc:
A vector satisfying the variational equation for a continuous linear functional is the
Lax--Milgram solution for that functional.

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.existsUnique_forall_eq
decls.doc:
Lax--Milgram as an existence-and-uniqueness theorem for arbitrary continuous linear
functionals.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_forall_eq (hB : IsCoercive B) (ℓ : StrongDual ℝ V) :
    ∃! u : V, ∀ v : V, B u v = ℓ v

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoercive.exists_forall_eq
decls.doc: Lax--Milgram as an existence theorem for arbitrary continuous linear functionals.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_forall_eq (hB : IsCoercive B) (ℓ : StrongDual ℝ V) :
    ∃ u : V, ∀ v : V, B u v = ℓ v

decls.name: HilbertBasis.hasSum_norm_sq_inner
decls.doc:
**Parseval's identity, norm-square form.** The squared coordinates of `x` in a Hilbert basis
sum to `‖x‖²`, as a convergent series of real numbers.
decls.title: Parseval's identity, norm-square form
decls.statement:
theorem _root_.HilbertBasis.hasSum_norm_sq_inner (b : _root_.HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E) :
    HasSum (fun i => ‖inner 𝕜 (b i) x‖ ^ 2) (‖x‖ ^ 2)

decls.name: HilbertBasis.tsum_norm_sq_inner
decls.doc:
**Parseval's identity, norm-square form** (`tsum` version of
`HilbertBasis.hasSum_norm_sq_inner`).
decls.title: Parseval's identity, norm-square form
decls.statement:
theorem _root_.HilbertBasis.tsum_norm_sq_inner (b : _root_.HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E) :
    ∑' i : ι, ‖inner 𝕜 (b i) x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2

decls.name: HilbertBasis.summable_norm_sq_inner
decls.doc: The squared coordinate family of a vector is summable.
decls.statement:
theorem _root_.HilbertBasis.summable_norm_sq_inner (b : _root_.HilbertBasis ι 𝕜 E) (x : E) :
    Summable fun i => ‖inner 𝕜 (b i) x‖ ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.memLp_two_algebraMap_eval
decls.doc: Every polynomial lies in `L²` of a measure carrying one finite exponential moment.
decls.statement:
theorem memLp_two_algebraMap_eval {ν : Measure ℝ}
    (hexp : ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a * |x|)) ν)
    (q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (q.eval x)) 2 ν

decls.name: TauCeti.memLp_two_algebraMap_eval_div
decls.doc:
Dividing by a constant keeps a polynomial in `L²`: `q/r` is again the evaluation of a
polynomial, namely `C r⁻¹ * q`. This also covers `r = 0`, where both sides are `0`.
decls.statement:
theorem memLp_two_algebraMap_eval_div {ν : Measure ℝ}
    (hexp : ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a * |x|)) ν)
    (q : Polynomial ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (q.eval x / r)) 2 ν

decls.name: TauCeti.memLp_two_bareNormalized
decls.doc:
The `MemLp` obligation of `TauCeti.bareNormalizedLp` for a polynomial family, discharged from
the one exponential moment that the completeness theorem already assumes. Supplied as the default
value of that theorem's `hmem` argument, so callers do not repeat this proof.
decls.statement:
theorem memLp_two_bareNormalized {ν : Measure ℝ}
    (hexp : ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a * |x|)) ν)
    (p : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ((p n).eval x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2 ν

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_algebraMap_eval_mul_eq_zero_of_span_eq_top
decls.doc:
**Spanning transfers a vanishing integral from a family to every polynomial.** If every
pairing `q ↦ ∫ q(x)·G(x)` is integrable, each pairing against a member `p n` vanishes, and the
`p n` span `ℝ[X]`, then the pairing against every polynomial vanishes.

Stated for an arbitrary measure and integrand: those three are the only inputs.
decls.title: Spanning transfers a vanishing integral from a family to every polynomial
decls.statement:
theorem integral_algebraMap_eval_mul_eq_zero_of_span_eq_top {ν : Measure ℝ}
    {G : ℝ → 𝕜} {p : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ} (hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range p) = ⊤)
    (hint : ∀ q : Polynomial ℝ, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (q.eval x) * G x) ν)
    (hfam : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ x, (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ((p n).eval x) * G x ∂ν = 0) (q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ∫ x, (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (q.eval x) * G x ∂ν = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.orthogonal_span_range_bareNormalizedLp_eq_bot_of_span_eq_top
decls.doc:
**Roadmap B1 → B2 bridge: completeness of a spanning polynomial family.**

If the weighted measure `w·μ` carries one finite exponential moment and `p` spans `ℝ[X]`, then the
normalized polynomials span a dense subspace of `L²(w·μ)` — the orthogonal complement of their span
is trivial. This is the `hcomplete` input that `TauCeti.hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure` consumes.

Spanning is all the argument uses; see
`TauCeti.orthogonal_span_range_bareNormalizedLp_eq_bot` for the exact-degree families that motivate
it.
decls.title: Roadmap B1 → B2 bridge: completeness of a spanning polynomial family
decls.statement:
theorem orthogonal_span_range_bareNormalizedLp_eq_bot_of_span_eq_top {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (p : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range p) = ⊤) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (hexp : ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a * |x|))
      (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ((p n).eval x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)) :=
      fun n => memLp_two_bareNormalized (𝕜 := 𝕜) hexp p c n) :
    (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range
      (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) (fun n x => (p n).eval x) w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.orthogonal_span_range_bareNormalizedLp_eq_bot
decls.doc:
**Completeness of an exact-degree polynomial family** — the specialization of
`TauCeti.orthogonal_span_range_bareNormalizedLp_eq_bot_of_span_eq_top` that every classical
orthogonal family satisfies.

Exact degrees make `p` a `Polynomial.Sequence`, and over a field every nonzero leading coefficient
is a unit, so `p` spans `ℝ[X]`.
decls.title: Completeness of an exact-degree polynomial family
decls.statement:
theorem orthogonal_span_range_bareNormalizedLp_eq_bot {μ : Measure ℝ}
    (p : ℕ → Polynomial ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hdeg : ∀ n, (p n).degree = (n : WithBot ℕ)) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (hexp : ∃ a : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a * |x|))
      (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) ((p n).eval x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)) :=
      fun n => memLp_two_bareNormalized (𝕜 := 𝕜) hexp p c n) :
    (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range
      (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) (fun n x => (p n).eval x) w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.bareNormalizedLp
decls.doc:
The bare normalized function `fₙ/√cₙ` as an element of `L²(w·μ; 𝕜)`, where
`w·μ = μ.withDensity (ENNReal.ofReal ∘ w)` and the real value is cast through `algebraMap ℝ 𝕜`.
decls.statement:
def bareNormalizedLp {μ : Measure α}
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (n : ℕ) :
    Lp 𝕜 2 (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))

decls.name: TauCeti.coeFn_bareNormalizedLp
decls.doc:
The `Lp` representative of `bareNormalizedLp` is the expected scalar-cast normalized
function.
decls.statement:
theorem coeFn_bareNormalizedLp {μ : Measure α}
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (n : ℕ) :
    ⇑(bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem n)
      =ᵐ[μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))]
        fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_mul_withDensity
decls.doc:
Changing the weighted measure back to `μ`: the `w·μ`-integral of a real product of function
values equals the `μ`-integral of that product times the weight `w`.
decls.statement:
theorem integral_mul_withDensity {μ : Measure α}
    (hwnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (m n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, f m x * f n x ∂(μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))))
      = ∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_bareNormalized_real
decls.doc: The `w·μ`-integral of the product of two normalized real functions is the Kronecker delta.
decls.statement:
theorem integral_bareNormalized_real {μ : Measure α}
    (hwnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (m n : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, (f m x / Real.sqrt (c m)) * (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))
        ∂(μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))))
      = if m = n then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.inner_bareNormalizedLp
decls.doc: The normalized bare functions have Kronecker-delta inner products in `L²(w·μ)`.
decls.statement:
theorem inner_bareNormalizedLp {μ : Measure α}
    (hwnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (m n : ℕ) :
    inner 𝕜 (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem m) (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem n)
      = if m = n then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.orthonormal_bareNormalizedLp
decls.doc:
**Orthonormality from the orthogonality relation.** The normalized bare functions
`fₙ/√cₙ` form an orthonormal family in `L²(w·μ)`.
decls.title: Orthonormality from the orthogonality relation
decls.statement:
theorem orthonormal_bareNormalizedLp {μ : Measure α}
    (hwnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) :
    Orthonormal 𝕜 (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)

decls.name: TauCeti.hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure
decls.doc:
**The weighted-measure basis.** The normalized bare functions, orthonormal by the
orthogonality relation and complete by hypothesis, form a Hilbert basis of `L²(w·μ)` — the textbook
statement that a family of orthogonal functions is an orthonormal basis of its own weighted `L²`
space.
decls.title: The weighted-measure basis
decls.statement:
def hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure {μ : Measure α}
    (hwnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))))
    (hcomplete :
      (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥) :
    HilbertBasis ℕ 𝕜 (Lp 𝕜 2 (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))))

decls.name: TauCeti.coe_hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure
decls.doc: Element-level characterization of the weighted-measure basis.
decls.statement:
theorem coe_hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure {μ : Measure α}
    (hwnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))))
    (hcomplete :
      (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥) :
    ⇑(hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure f w c hwnn hwm hc horth hmem hcomplete)
      = bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem

decls.name: TauCeti.hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem
decls.doc:
**The `√w`-envelope basis of `L²(μ)`.** The `weightL2Isometry`-image (multiplication by `√w`) of
the weighted-measure basis; the `√w`-normalized functions `fₙ·√w/√cₙ` form a Hilbert basis of the
reference measure `L²(μ)`, obtained with no separate proof.
decls.title: The `√w`-envelope basis of `L²(μ)`
decls.statement:
def hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem {μ : Measure α}
    (hwpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))))
    (hcomplete :
      (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥) :
    HilbertBasis ℕ 𝕜 (Lp 𝕜 2 μ)

decls.name: TauCeti.coe_hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem
decls.doc:
Element-level characterization of the `√w`-envelope basis: the `weightL2Isometry`-image of the
weighted-measure basis vector.
decls.statement:
theorem coe_hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem {μ : Measure α}
    (hwpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))))
    (hcomplete :
      (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥) (n : ℕ) :
    hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem f w c hwpos hwm hc horth hmem hcomplete n
      = weightL2Isometry μ w hwpos hwm (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem n)

decls.name: TauCeti.preimage_smul_vadd_ball_norm
decls.doc:
The affine normalization map `y ↦ c • y +ᵥ x` pulls the ball `Metric.ball x (‖c‖ * r)` back
to `Metric.ball 0 r`, for nonzero scale `c`.
decls.statement:
theorem preimage_smul_vadd_ball_norm (x : P) {c : 𝕜} (hc : c ≠ 0) (r : ℝ) :
    ((fun y : E ↦ c • y +ᵥ x) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x (‖c‖ * r)) = Metric.ball 0 r

decls.name: TauCeti.preimage_smul_vadd_closedBall
decls.doc:
The affine map `y ↦ c • y +ᵥ x` pulls the closed ball of radius `‖c‖ * r` about `x`
back to the closed ball of radius `r` about `0`.
decls.statement:
theorem preimage_smul_vadd_closedBall (x : P) {c : 𝕜} (hc : c ≠ 0) (r : ℝ) :
    ((fun y : E ↦ c • y +ᵥ x) ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall x (‖c‖ * r)) =
      Metric.closedBall 0 r

decls.name: TauCeti.preimage_smul_vadd_sphere
decls.doc:
The affine map `y ↦ c • y +ᵥ x` pulls the sphere of radius `‖c‖ * r` about `x`
back to the sphere of radius `r` about `0`.
decls.statement:
theorem preimage_smul_vadd_sphere (x : P) {c : 𝕜} (hc : c ≠ 0) (r : ℝ) :
    ((fun y : E ↦ c • y +ᵥ x) ⁻¹' Metric.sphere x (‖c‖ * r)) = Metric.sphere 0 r

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormDecidableEq
decls.doc: Local classical decidable equality for finite coordinate indices in energy-form proofs.
decls.statement: instance energyFormDecidableEq : DecidableEq n

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand
decls.doc:
The pointwise weak-form (energy) integrand of a divergence-form operator
`L u = -∂ⱼ(aⁱʲ ∂ᵢu) + bⁱ ∂ᵢu + c u`, as a bundled continuous bilinear form on jets
`(value, gradient) ∈ ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n`.

On jets `U = (u, ∇u)` and `V = (v, ∇v)` it evaluates to
`⟨a ∇u, ∇v⟩ + ⟪b, ∇u⟫ v + c u v`, the integrand of `a(u, v)`. Bundling it as a
`ContinuousLinearMap` lets it feed Mathlib's bounded-bilinear-form and Lax--Milgram APIs
once the energy form is integrated over the Sobolev space.
decls.statement:
def energyIntegrand (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : ℝ) :
    (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) →L[ℝ] ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_apply
decls.doc: The jet form evaluates to `⟨a ∇u, ∇v⟩ + ⟪b, ∇u⟫ v + c u v` on jets `U`, `V`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : ℝ)
    (U V : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    energyIntegrand A b c U V
      = matrixBilinearForm A V.2 U.2 + driftForm b V.1 U.2 + massForm c U.1 V.1

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_self
decls.doc: The diagonal of the jet form, the energy density `⟨a ∇u, ∇u⟩ + ⟪b, ∇u⟫ u + c u²`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_self (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
    (c : ℝ) (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    energyIntegrand A b c U U
      = A.toQuadraticForm' U.2 + ⟪b, U.2⟫_ℝ * U.1 + c * U.1 ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_one_zero_zero_apply
decls.doc:
The Laplacian model `−Δ` (`a = 1`, no drift, no mass) has jet form the Dirichlet
integrand `⟨∇u, ∇v⟩`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_one_zero_zero_apply (U V : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 0 U V = V.2 ⬝ᵥ U.2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_one_zero_zero_self
decls.doc: The diagonal of the Laplacian model's jet form is the Dirichlet energy density `‖∇u‖²`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_one_zero_zero_self (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 0 U U = ‖U.2‖ ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_apply
decls.doc:
The shifted Laplacian model `-Δ + c` has jet form
`(U, V) ↦ ∇u · ∇v + c u v`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_apply (c : ℝ)
    (U V : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c U V = V.2 ⬝ᵥ U.2 + c * U.1 * V.1

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_self
decls.doc:
The shifted Laplacian model `-Δ + c` has diagonal jet density
`‖∇u‖² + c u²`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_self (c : ℝ)
    (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c U U = ‖U.2‖ ^ 2 + c * U.1 ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.mul_norm_abs_le_half_mul_sq_add
decls.doc:
Weighted Young inequality in the form used to absorb the first-order drift term into
half of the ellipticity floor.
decls.statement:
lemma mul_norm_abs_le_half_mul_sq_add (hlam : 0 < lam) (beta u : ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    beta * r * |u| ≤ lam / 2 * r ^ 2 + beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) * u ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.abs_dotProduct_one_mulVec_le
decls.statement:
lemma abs_dotProduct_one_mulVec_le (η ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    |η ⬝ᵥ ((1 : Matrix n n ℝ) *ᵥ ξ)| ≤ 1 * ‖η‖ * ‖ξ‖

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.norm_energyIntegrand_apply_le_of_bounds
decls.doc:
Pointwise boundedness of the jet form with explicit constant `Λ + β + γ`: the principal,
drift, and mass contributions are each controlled by the corresponding constant times the jet
norms.
decls.statement:
lemma norm_energyIntegrand_apply_le_of_bounds (hLam : 0 ≤ Lam)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {c₀ : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ η ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, |η ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ξ)| ≤ Lam * ‖η‖ * ‖ξ‖)
    (hb : ‖b₀‖ ≤ beta) (hc : ‖c₀‖ ≤ gamma)
    (U V : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖energyIntegrand A b₀ c₀ U V‖ ≤ (Lam + beta + gamma) * ‖U‖ * ‖V‖

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.opNorm_energyIntegrand_le_of_bounds
decls.doc:
The operator norm of the pointwise jet form is at most `Λ + β + γ`.

This finite-dimensional estimate is consumed after integration to prove boundedness of the
Sobolev-space energy form; it is not itself the Lax--Milgram boundedness hypothesis.
decls.statement:
lemma opNorm_energyIntegrand_le_of_bounds (hLam : 0 ≤ Lam)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {c₀ : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀ η ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, |η ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ξ)| ≤ Lam * ‖η‖ * ‖ξ‖)
    (hb : ‖b₀‖ ≤ beta) (hc : ‖c₀‖ ≤ gamma) :
    ‖energyIntegrand A b₀ c₀‖ ≤ Lam + beta + gamma

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.norm_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_apply_le
decls.doc: Pointwise boundedness of the shifted Laplacian jet form with constant `1 + ‖c‖`.
decls.statement:
lemma norm_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_apply_le (c : ℝ)
    (U V : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c U V‖ ≤
      (1 + ‖c‖) * ‖U‖ * ‖V‖

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.opNorm_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_le
decls.doc: Operator-norm boundedness of the shifted Laplacian jet form with constant `1 + ‖c‖`.
decls.statement:
lemma opNorm_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_le (c : ℝ) :
    ‖energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c‖ ≤ 1 + ‖c‖

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.garding_energyIntegrand_self_of_bounds
decls.doc:
**Pointwise Gårding inequality.** With a nonnegative mass coefficient (`c ≥ 0`), the
diagonal of the jet form is bounded below by `(λ/2)‖∇u‖² − (β²/2λ)|u|²`. The ellipticity
floor `λ‖∇u‖²` pays for the drift term via Young's inequality, leaving half the floor and a
mass defect proportional to `β²/λ`. Integrating over `Ω` this is Gårding's inequality
`a(u, u) ≥ (λ/2)‖∇u‖²_{L²} − (β²/2λ)‖u‖²_{L²}`.
decls.title: Pointwise Gårding inequality
decls.statement:
lemma garding_energyIntegrand_self_of_bounds (hlam : 0 < lam)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {c₀ : ℝ}
    (hQ : ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ A.toQuadraticForm' ξ)
    (hb : ‖b₀‖ ≤ beta) (hc : 0 ≤ c₀)
    (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    lam / 2 * ‖U.2‖ ^ 2 - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) * U.1 ^ 2
      ≤ energyIntegrand A b₀ c₀ U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrandLinear
decls.doc: The coefficient triple-to-energy-integrand map as a continuous linear map.

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrandLinear_apply
decls.doc: Applying `energyIntegrandLinear` recovers `energyIntegrand` for the coefficient triple.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrandLinear_apply (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : ℝ) :
    energyIntegrandLinear (n := n) (A, b, c) = energyIntegrand A b c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.continuous_energyIntegrand
decls.doc: The full coefficient triple-to-energy-integrand map is continuous.
decls.statement:
lemma continuous_energyIntegrand :
    Continuous (fun p : Matrix n n ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n × ℝ =>
      energyIntegrand p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.Continuous.energyIntegrand
decls.doc:
Continuous coefficient fields give a continuous field of full pointwise energy
integrands.

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.ContinuousOn.energyIntegrand
decls.doc:
Continuous coefficient fields on a set give a continuous field of full pointwise energy
integrands on that set.

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegrabilityDecidableEq
decls.doc:
Local classical decidable equality for finite coordinate indices in uniform-ellipticity
wrappers.
decls.statement: instance energyFormIntegrabilityDecidableEq : DecidableEq n

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integrable_energyIntegrand_apply₂_of_integrable_norm_mul
decls.doc:
Bounded measurable coefficient fields and an integrable product of jet norms give an
integrable scalar energy density.
decls.statement:
lemma integrable_energyIntegrand_apply₂_of_integrable_norm_mul
    {a : α → Matrix n n ℝ} {b : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {c : α → ℝ}
    {U V : α → ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {Lam beta gamma : ℝ}
    (hLam : 0 ≤ Lam)
    (ha : AEStronglyMeasurable a μ) (hb : AEStronglyMeasurable b μ)

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_zero
decls.doc: The zero coefficient triple has zero pointwise energy integrand.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_zero :
    energyIntegrand (0 : Matrix n n ℝ) (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 0 = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_add
decls.doc: The pointwise energy integrand is additive in its coefficient triple.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_add :
    energyIntegrand (A + B) (b + d) (c + e) =
      energyIntegrand A b c + energyIntegrand B d e

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_add_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise evaluation form of `energyIntegrand_add`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_add_apply :
    energyIntegrand (A + B) (b + d) (c + e) U V =
      energyIntegrand A b c U V + energyIntegrand B d e U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_neg
decls.doc: The pointwise energy integrand is compatible with negating all coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_neg :
    energyIntegrand (-A) (-b) (-c) = -energyIntegrand A b c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_neg_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise evaluation form of `energyIntegrand_neg`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_neg_apply :
    energyIntegrand (-A) (-b) (-c) U V = -energyIntegrand A b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_sub
decls.doc: The pointwise energy integrand is subtractive in its coefficient triple.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_sub :
    energyIntegrand (A - B) (b - d) (c - e) =
      energyIntegrand A b c - energyIntegrand B d e

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_sub_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise evaluation form of `energyIntegrand_sub`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_sub_apply :
    energyIntegrand (A - B) (b - d) (c - e) U V =
      energyIntegrand A b c U V - energyIntegrand B d e U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_smul
decls.doc: The pointwise energy integrand is homogeneous in its coefficient triple.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_smul :
    energyIntegrand (r • A) (r • b) (r * c) = r • energyIntegrand A b c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_smul_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise evaluation form of `energyIntegrand_smul`.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_smul_apply :
    energyIntegrand (r • A) (r • b) (r * c) U V = r * energyIntegrand A b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_principal_add_lowerOrder
decls.doc: The full energy integrand splits into its principal part and lower-order part.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_principal_add_lowerOrder :
    energyIntegrand A b c =
      energyIntegrand A 0 0 + energyIntegrand 0 b c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_principal_drift_mass
decls.doc: The full energy integrand splits into its principal, drift, and mass pieces.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_principal_drift_mass :
    energyIntegrand A b c =
      energyIntegrand A 0 0 + energyIntegrand 0 b 0 + energyIntegrand 0 0 c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_eq_one_zero_baseMass_add_perturbation
decls.doc:
The full energy integrand is the sum of a shifted Laplacian model with chosen base mass
and the residual perturbation of the coefficient triple.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_eq_one_zero_baseMass_add_perturbation :
    energyIntegrand A b c =
      energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 m +
        energyIntegrand (A - 1) b (c - m)

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_eq_one_zero_baseMass_add_perturbation_apply
decls.doc: Pointwise form of the shifted-Laplacian-plus-residual-perturbation decomposition.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_eq_one_zero_baseMass_add_perturbation_apply :
    energyIntegrand A b c U V =
      energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 m U V +
        energyIntegrand (A - 1) b (c - m) U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyIntegrand_eq_one_zero_mass_add_perturbation
decls.doc:
The full energy integrand is the sum of a shifted Laplacian model and a perturbation of
the principal and drift coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma energyIntegrand_eq_one_zero_mass_add_perturbation :
    energyIntegrand A b c =
      energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c +
        energyIntegrand (A - 1) b 0

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpDecidableEq
decls.doc: The classical decidable equality used for finite-dimensional matrix computations.
decls.statement: instance energyFormLpDecidableEq : DecidableEq n

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp
decls.doc:
The constant-coefficient divergence-form energy form on square-integrable
value-gradient jets.

This is the Hölder pairing induced by `energyIntegrand A b c`; in particular it is bundled as
a continuous bilinear map, with no integrability hypotheses required at use sites.
decls.statement:
def energyFormLp (μ : Measure X) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : ℝ) :
    Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ →L[ℝ]
      Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ →L[ℝ] ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_apply
decls.doc: The `L²` energy form is the integral of the pointwise jet energy density.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_apply (μ : Measure X) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : ℝ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ A b c U V =
      ∫ x, energyIntegrand A b c (U x) (V x) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_apply
decls.doc:
The shifted-Laplacian energy form is the sum of the gradient pairing and the mass
pairing.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_apply (μ : Measure X) (c : ℝ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c U V =
      ∫ x, ((V x).2 ⬝ᵥ (U x).2 + c * (U x).1 * (V x).1) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_one_zero_zero_apply
decls.doc: The Dirichlet energy form pairs the gradient components of two `L²` jets.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_one_zero_zero_apply (μ : Measure X)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 0 U V =
      ∫ x, (V x).2 ⬝ᵥ (U x).2 ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_self
decls.doc:
The diagonal of the shifted-Laplacian `L²` energy form is the integral of the squared
gradient norm plus the mass density.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_self (μ : Measure X) (c : ℝ)
    (U : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c U U =
      ∫ x, (‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 + c * (U x).1 ^ 2) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_one_zero_zero_self
decls.doc:
The diagonal of the Dirichlet `L²` energy form is the integral of the squared gradient
norm.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_one_zero_zero_self (μ : Measure X)
    (U : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 0 U U =
      ∫ x, ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_self
decls.doc:
Replacing the principal coefficient by its symmetric part does not change the diagonal
`L²` energy form.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_self (μ : Measure X) (A : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : ℝ)
    (U : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (coefficientSymmetricPart A) b c U U =
      energyFormLp μ A b c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_apply
decls.doc:
The symmetric-part zero-drift `L²` energy form is the average of the original form and
its transpose.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_apply (μ : Measure X)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c : ℝ) (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (coefficientSymmetricPart A) 0 c U V =
      (energyFormLp μ A 0 c U V + energyFormLp μ A 0 c V U) / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_zero_drift_transpose_apply
decls.doc:
Transposing the principal coefficient swaps the two arguments of a zero-drift `L²` energy
form.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_zero_drift_transpose_apply (μ : Measure X) (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ Aᵀ 0 c U V = energyFormLp μ A 0 c V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_zero_drift_comm_of_isSymm
decls.doc: A symmetric principal coefficient gives a symmetric zero-drift `L²` energy form.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_zero_drift_comm_of_isSymm {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsSymm)
    (μ : Measure X) (c : ℝ) (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ A 0 c U V = energyFormLp μ A 0 c V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_zero_drift_flip_eq_of_isSymm
decls.doc:
A symmetric principal coefficient makes the zero-drift `L²` energy form equal to its
flip.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_zero_drift_flip_eq_of_isSymm {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsSymm)
    (μ : Measure X) (c : ℝ) :
    (energyFormLp μ A 0 c).flip = energyFormLp μ A 0 c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_comm
decls.doc: The symmetric-part zero-drift `L²` energy form is symmetric.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_comm (μ : Measure X)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c : ℝ) (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (coefficientSymmetricPart A) 0 c U V =
      energyFormLp μ (coefficientSymmetricPart A) 0 c V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_flip_eq
decls.doc: The symmetric-part zero-drift `L²` energy form is equal to its flip.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_flip_eq (μ : Measure X)
    (A : Matrix n n ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (energyFormLp μ (coefficientSymmetricPart A) 0 c).flip =
      energyFormLp μ (coefficientSymmetricPart A) 0 c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_comm
decls.doc: The shifted-Laplacian `L²` energy form is symmetric.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_comm (μ : Measure X) (c : ℝ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c U V =
      energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_flip_eq
decls.doc: The shifted-Laplacian `L²` energy form is equal to its flip.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLp_one_zero_mass_flip_eq (μ : Measure X) (c : ℝ) :
    (energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c).flip =
      energyFormLp μ (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable
decls.doc:
The variable-coefficient divergence-form energy form on square-integrable value-gradient
jets.

The `MemLp ... ⊤ μ` argument records exactly that the pointwise energy forms are strongly
measurable and essentially bounded.  Its proof is irrelevant to the resulting form.
decls.statement:
def energyFormLpVariable (μ : Measure X) (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ)
    (b : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x)) ⊤ μ) :
    Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ →L[ℝ]
      Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ →L[ℝ] ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_apply
decls.doc:
The variable-coefficient `L²` energy form is the integral of the pointwise jet energy
density.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_apply (μ : Measure X) (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ)
    (b : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLpVariable μ a b c hcoeff U V =
      ∫ x, energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (V x) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_proof_irrel
decls.doc:
The variable-coefficient energy form is independent of the proof that its coefficient
field belongs to `L∞`.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_proof_irrel (μ : Measure X) (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ)
    (b : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff hcoeff' : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x)) ⊤ μ) :
    energyFormLpVariable μ a b c hcoeff = energyFormLpVariable μ a b c hcoeff'

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_congr_ae
decls.doc:
Almost-everywhere equal coefficient fields induce the same variable-coefficient energy
form.

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_zero_drift_transpose_apply
decls.doc:
Transposing the principal coefficient swaps the arguments of a variable zero-drift energy
form.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_zero_drift_transpose_apply (μ : Measure X)
    (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x)ᵀ 0 (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (hcoeff' : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLpVariable μ (fun x => (a x)ᵀ) (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff U V =
      energyFormLpVariable μ a (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff' V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_zero_drift_comm_of_isSymm_ae
decls.doc:
An a.e. symmetric principal coefficient gives a symmetric variable zero-drift energy
form.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_zero_drift_comm_of_isSymm_ae {μ : Measure X}
    {a : X → Matrix n n ℝ} (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (a x).IsSymm) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLpVariable μ a (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff U V =
      energyFormLpVariable μ a (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_zero_drift_flip_eq_of_isSymm_ae
decls.doc:
An a.e. symmetric principal coefficient makes the variable zero-drift energy form equal
to its flip.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_zero_drift_flip_eq_of_isSymm_ae {μ : Measure X}
    {a : X → Matrix n n ℝ} (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (a x).IsSymm) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 (c x)) ⊤ μ) :
    (energyFormLpVariable μ a (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff).flip =
      energyFormLpVariable μ a (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_self
decls.doc:
Replacing the principal coefficient by its symmetric part does not change the diagonal
variable energy form.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_self (μ : Measure X)
    (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ) (b : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (coefficientSymmetricPart (a x))
      (b x) (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (hcoeff' : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (U : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLpVariable μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x)) b c hcoeff U U =
      energyFormLpVariable μ a b c hcoeff' U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_apply
decls.doc:
The symmetric-part variable zero-drift energy form is the average of the original form and
its transpose.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_apply (μ : Measure X)
    (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hsymm : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (coefficientSymmetricPart (a x)) 0
      (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLpVariable μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x))
        (fun _ => 0) c hsymm U V =
      (energyFormLpVariable μ a (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff U V +
        energyFormLpVariable μ a (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff V U) / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_comm
decls.doc: The symmetric-part variable zero-drift energy form is symmetric.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_comm (μ : Measure X)
    (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (coefficientSymmetricPart (a x)) 0
      (c x)) ⊤ μ)
    (U V : Lp (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) 2 μ) :
    energyFormLpVariable μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x))
        (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff U V =
      energyFormLpVariable μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x))
        (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_flip_eq
decls.doc: The symmetric-part variable zero-drift energy form is equal to its flip.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormLpVariable_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_flip_eq (μ : Measure X)
    (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ) (c : X → ℝ)
    (hcoeff : MemLp (fun x => energyIntegrand (coefficientSymmetricPart (a x)) 0
      (c x)) ⊤ μ) :
    (energyFormLpVariable μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x))
      (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff).flip =
      energyFormLpVariable μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x))
        (fun _ => 0) c hcoeff

decls.doc: Local classical decidable equality for finite coordinate indices in lower-bound proofs.
decls.statement: instance energyLowerBoundsDecidableEq : DecidableEq n

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.min_mul_prod_norm_sq_le_add
decls.doc:
The square of the product sup norm is controlled by the two squared coordinate norms
with the smaller coefficient.
decls.statement:
lemma min_mul_prod_norm_sq_le_add (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu)
    {E F : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [SeminormedAddCommGroup F] (U : E × F) :
    min lam mu * ‖U‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam * ‖U.2‖ ^ 2 + mu * ‖U.1‖ ^ 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.garding_energyIntegrand_self_of_mass_lower_bound_of_bounds
decls.doc:
Pointwise lower bound for the energy integrand with bounded drift and a mass lower bound.

If the principal part has quadratic lower bound `λ‖ξ‖²`, the drift satisfies `‖b₀‖ ≤ β`, and
the mass coefficient satisfies `μ ≤ c₀`, then the diagonal of the jet form is bounded below by
`(λ/2)‖∇u‖² + (μ − β²/2λ)|u|²`.
decls.statement:
lemma garding_energyIntegrand_self_of_mass_lower_bound_of_bounds (hlam : 0 < lam)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {c₀ : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ A.toQuadraticForm' ξ)
    (hb : ‖b₀‖ ≤ beta) (hc : mu ≤ c₀) (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    lam / 2 * ‖U.2‖ ^ 2 + (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * U.1 ^ 2
      ≤ energyIntegrand A b₀ c₀ U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.min_diagonal_lower_bound_mul_norm_sq_le_energyIntegrand_self
decls.doc:
The mass-floor Gårding lower bound implies the explicit diagonal estimate with constant
`min (λ / 2) (μ - β² / (2λ))`, assuming this second coefficient is nonnegative.
decls.statement:
lemma min_diagonal_lower_bound_mul_norm_sq_le_energyIntegrand_self (hlam : 0 < lam)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {c₀ : ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ A.toQuadraticForm' ξ)
    (hb : ‖b₀‖ ≤ beta) (hc : mu ≤ c₀) (hmu : beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) ≤ mu)
    (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    min (lam / 2) (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * ‖U‖ ^ 2
      ≤ energyIntegrand A b₀ c₀ U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.min_lam_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyIntegrand_zero_drift_self
decls.doc:
Zero-drift diagonal lower bound from a principal quadratic lower bound and nonnegative
mass coefficient.
decls.statement:
lemma min_lam_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyIntegrand_zero_drift_self {A : Matrix n n ℝ}
    {c₀ : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hA : ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ A.toQuadraticForm' ξ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c₀) (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    min lam c₀ * ‖U‖ ^ 2 ≤ energyIntegrand A 0 c₀ U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.min_one_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_self
decls.doc: Explicit diagonal lower bound for the shifted Laplacian jet form with nonnegative mass.
decls.statement:
lemma min_one_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyIntegrand_one_zero_mass_self {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (U : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    min 1 c * ‖U‖ ^ 2 ≤ energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.planarNewtonianKernel
decls.doc:
The Newtonian kernel for the negative Laplacian on the plane, represented as `ℂ`.

The value assigned at the pole is immaterial for the pointwise theory in this file.  Lean's
convention `Real.log 0 = 0` makes this a total function; analytically, the kernel has a logarithmic
singularity there.
decls.statement: def planarNewtonianKernel (z : ℂ) : ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.planarNewtonianKernel_def
decls.doc: The defining formula for the planar Newtonian kernel.
decls.statement:
theorem planarNewtonianKernel_def (z : ℂ) :
    planarNewtonianKernel z = -(2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * Real.log ‖z‖

decls.name: TauCeti.planarNewtonianKernel_zero
decls.statement: theorem planarNewtonianKernel_zero : planarNewtonianKernel 0 = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.planarNewtonianKernel_neg

theorem planarNewtonianKernel_neg (z : ℂ) :
    planarNewtonianKernel (-z) = planarNewtonianKernel z

decls.doc: The planar Newtonian kernel is invariant under multiplication by a unit complex number.
decls.statement:
theorem planarNewtonianKernel_unit_mul {u z : ℂ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    planarNewtonianKernel (u * z) = planarNewtonianKernel z

decls.name: TauCeti.planarNewtonianKernel_mul

    planarNewtonianKernel (z * w) = planarNewtonianKernel z + planarNewtonianKernel w

TauCeti.harnack_factor_mono
decls.statement:
lemma harnack_factor_mono {R s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t < R) :
    (R + s) / (R - s) ≤ (R + t) / (R - t)

decls.name: TauCeti.le_harnack_factor_mul_of_mul_le

lemma le_harnack_factor_mul_of_mul_le {R d a b : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hdR : d < R)
    (h : (R - d) / (R + d) * a ≤ b) :
    a ≤ (R + d) / (R - d) * b

decls.name: TauCeti.circleAverage_smul_le_circleAverage_smul_of_le_on_sphere
decls.doc:
**A pointwise kernel bound on the boundary circle transfers to the circle averages.** If `f`
is nonnegative on `sphere c |R|` and `g₁ ≤ g₂` there, then multiplying by `f` preserves the
inequality under `circleAverage`.

The hypotheses are stated on `sphere c |R|`, the circle `circleAverage` integrates over, so no
sign condition on `R` is needed.
decls.title: A pointwise kernel bound on the boundary circle transfers to the circle averages
decls.statement:
theorem circleAverage_smul_le_circleAverage_smul_of_le_on_sphere {g₁ g₂ : ℂ → ℝ}
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, 0 ≤ f z)
    (h₁ : CircleIntegrable (g₁ • f) c R) (h₂ : CircleIntegrable (g₂ • f) c R)
    (hle : ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, g₁ z ≤ g₂ z) :
    circleAverage (g₁ • f) c R ≤ circleAverage (g₂ • f) c R

decls.name: TauCeti.harnack_inequality_center_of_nonneg_on_sphere
decls.doc:
**The centered Harnack inequality on a planar disk.**

If `f` is harmonic on a neighborhood of the closed disk of radius `R` about `c` and is
nonnegative on its boundary circle, then every `w` in the open disk satisfies

`(R - ‖w - c‖) / (R + ‖w - c‖) * f c ≤ f w
  ≤ (R + ‖w - c‖) / (R - ‖w - c‖) * f c`.

The boundary-only sign assumption is sufficient: both inequalities follow from the Poisson
integral formula and the pointwise bounds on the Poisson kernel.
decls.title: The centered Harnack inequality on a planar disk
decls.statement:
theorem harnack_inequality_center_of_nonneg_on_sphere
    (hf : HarmonicOnNhd f (closedBall c R))
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, 0 ≤ f z) (hw : w ∈ ball c R) :
    (R - ‖w - c‖) / (R + ‖w - c‖) * f c ≤ f w ∧
      f w ≤ (R + ‖w - c‖) / (R - ‖w - c‖) * f c

decls.name: TauCeti.nonneg_of_mem_ball_of_harmonicOnNhd_of_nonneg_on_sphere
decls.doc:
A function harmonic near a closed planar disk and nonnegative on its boundary circle is
nonnegative throughout the open disk.
decls.statement:
theorem nonneg_of_mem_ball_of_harmonicOnNhd_of_nonneg_on_sphere
    (hf : HarmonicOnNhd f (closedBall c R))
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, 0 ≤ f z) (hw : w ∈ ball c R) :
    0 ≤ f w

decls.name: TauCeti.harnack_inequality_of_nonneg_on_sphere
decls.doc:
**Harnack's inequality on a smaller planar disk.**

Let `0 ≤ r < R`.  If `f` is harmonic on a neighborhood of `closedBall c R` and nonnegative on
its boundary, then for any `x, y ∈ closedBall c r`,

`f x ≤ ((R + r) / (R - r)) ^ 2 * f y`.

This pairwise form follows by comparing both values with `f c`.
decls.title: Harnack's inequality on a smaller planar disk
decls.statement:
theorem harnack_inequality_of_nonneg_on_sphere
    (hf : HarmonicOnNhd f (closedBall c R))
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, 0 ≤ f z) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r < R)
    {x y : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ closedBall c r) (hy : y ∈ closedBall c r) :
    f x ≤ ((R + r) / (R - r)) ^ 2 * f y

decls.name: TauCeti.eq_zero_on_ball_of_harmonicOnNhd_of_nonneg_on_sphere_of_eq_zero
decls.doc:
If a function is harmonic near a closed planar disk, is nonnegative on the boundary, and
vanishes at an interior point, then it vanishes throughout the open disk.

This is the zero case of Harnack's inequality, and is the strong minimum principle for this
setting.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_zero_on_ball_of_harmonicOnNhd_of_nonneg_on_sphere_of_eq_zero
    (hf : HarmonicOnNhd f (closedBall c R))
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, 0 ≤ f z) (hw : w ∈ ball c R) (hfw : f w = 0) :
    Set.EqOn f 0 (ball c R)

decls.name: TauCeti.harnack_inequality_center
decls.doc:
**The centered Harnack inequality on an open planar disk.**

If `f` is harmonic and nonnegative throughout the open disk of radius `R` about `c`, then
every `w` in the disk satisfies the sharp two-sided comparison with `f c`.
decls.title: The centered Harnack inequality on an open planar disk
decls.statement:
theorem harnack_inequality_center (hf : HarmonicOnNhd f (ball c R))
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ ball c R, 0 ≤ f z) (hw : w ∈ ball c R) :
    (R - ‖w - c‖) / (R + ‖w - c‖) * f c ≤ f w ∧
      f w ≤ (R + ‖w - c‖) / (R - ‖w - c‖) * f c

decls.name: TauCeti.harnack_inequality
decls.doc:
**Harnack's inequality on a smaller closed disk.**

Let `0 ≤ r < R`.  If `f` is harmonic and nonnegative throughout `ball c R`, then for any
`x, y ∈ closedBall c r`,

`f x ≤ ((R + r) / (R - r)) ^ 2 * f y`.
decls.title: Harnack's inequality on a smaller closed disk
decls.statement:
theorem harnack_inequality (hf : HarmonicOnNhd f (ball c R))
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ ball c R, 0 ≤ f z) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrR : r < R)
    {x y : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ closedBall c r) (hy : y ∈ closedBall c r) :
    f x ≤ ((R + r) / (R - r)) ^ 2 * f y

decls.name: TauCeti.eq_zero_on_ball_of_harmonicOnNhd_of_nonneg_of_eq_zero
decls.doc:
A nonnegative harmonic function on an open planar disk that vanishes at one point vanishes
throughout the disk.  This is the zero case of Harnack's inequality.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_zero_on_ball_of_harmonicOnNhd_of_nonneg_of_eq_zero
    (hf : HarmonicOnNhd f (ball c R))
    (hnonneg : ∀ z ∈ ball c R, 0 ≤ f z) (hw : w ∈ ball c R) (hfw : f w = 0) :
    Set.EqOn f 0 (ball c R)

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integratedEnergyFormDecidableEq
decls.doc: Local classical decidable equality for finite coordinate indices in integrated energy proofs.
decls.statement: instance integratedEnergyFormDecidableEq : DecidableEq n

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral
decls.doc:
The scalar energy form obtained by integrating the divergence-form pointwise jet
integrand against a measure.

For a Sobolev function `u`, the intended jet field is `x ↦ (u x, ∇u x)`.  This definition stays
at the raw-jet level because the roadmap's weak-derivative Sobolev spaces are a separate
prerequisite.

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_def
decls.doc: Unfolding rule for the integrated energy form.
decls.statement:
theorem energyFormIntegral_def (μ : Measure X) (a : X → Matrix n n ℝ)
    (b : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ n) (c : X → ℝ)
    (U V : X → ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V =
      ∫ x, (energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (V x)) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_congr_ae
decls.doc:
The integrated energy form respects almost-everywhere equality of all coefficient and jet
fields.

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_zero_left
decls.doc: The integrated energy form vanishes when the left jet field is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_left :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c (fun _ => 0) V = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_zero_right
decls.doc: The integrated energy form vanishes when the right jet field is zero.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_right :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U (fun _ => 0) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_zero_coefficients
decls.doc: The zero coefficient triple gives the zero integrated energy form.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_coefficients :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) U V = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integral_congr_forall
decls.statement:
lemma integral_congr_forall {f g : X → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂μ = ∫ x, g x ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_neg_left
decls.doc: Negating the left jet field negates the integrated energy form.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_neg_left :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c (fun x => -U x) V = -energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_neg_right
decls.doc: Negating the right jet field negates the integrated energy form.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_neg_right :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U (fun x => -V x) = -energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_neg_coefficients
decls.doc: Negating the coefficient triple negates the integrated energy form.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_neg_coefficients :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => -a x) (fun x => -b x) (fun x => -c x) U V =
      -energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_add_left
decls.doc:
Additivity in the left jet field, assuming the two summand energy densities are
integrable.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_add_left
    (hU : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hW : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (W x) (V x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c (fun x => U x + W x) V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V + energyFormIntegral μ a b c W V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_add_right
decls.doc:
Additivity in the right jet field, assuming the two summand energy densities are
integrable.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_add_right
    (hV : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hW : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (W x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U (fun x => V x + W x) =
      energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V + energyFormIntegral μ a b c U W

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_smul_left
decls.doc: Homogeneity in the left jet field.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_smul_left (r : ℝ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c (fun x => r • U x) V =
      r * energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_smul_right
decls.doc: Homogeneity in the right jet field.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_smul_right (r : ℝ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U (fun x => r • V x) =
      r * energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_add
decls.doc:
The integrated energy form is additive in the coefficient triple, under the corresponding
integrability assumptions for the two summand densities.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_add
    (h : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (h' : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a' x) (b' x) (c' x) (U x) (V x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => a x + a' x) (fun x => b x + b' x) (fun x => c x + c' x)
        U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V + energyFormIntegral μ a' b' c' U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_sub
decls.doc:
The integrated energy form is subtractive in the coefficient triple, under the
corresponding integrability assumptions for the two densities.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_sub
    (h : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (h' : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a' x) (b' x) (c' x) (U x) (V x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => a x - a' x) (fun x => b x - b' x) (fun x => c x - c' x)
        U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V - energyFormIntegral μ a' b' c' U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_smul
decls.doc: The integrated energy form is homogeneous in the coefficient triple.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_smul :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => r • a x) (fun x => r • b x) (fun x => r * c x) U V =
      r * energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_principal_add_lowerOrder
decls.doc: The integrated full energy form splits into its principal and lower-order parts.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_principal_add_lowerOrder
    (hprincipal : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 0 (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hlower : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand 0 (b x) (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) U V +
        energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => 0) b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_principal_drift_mass
decls.doc: The integrated full energy form splits into its principal, drift, and mass pieces.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_principal_drift_mass
    (hprincipal : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 0 (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hdrift : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand 0 (b x) 0 (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hmass : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand 0 0 (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) U V +
        energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => 0) b (fun _ => 0) U V +
          energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_eq_one_zero_baseMass_add_perturbation
decls.doc:
The integrated full energy form is a shifted-Laplacian model plus the residual
coefficient perturbation.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_eq_one_zero_baseMass_add_perturbation
    (hmodel : Integrable
      (fun x => energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 (m x) (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hpert : Integrable
      (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x - 1) (b x) (c x - m x) (U x) (V x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) m U V +
        energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => a x - 1) b (fun x => c x - m x) U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_eq_one_zero_mass_add_perturbation
decls.doc:
The integrated full energy form is the shifted-Laplacian form with the same mass plus the
principal-and-drift perturbation.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_eq_one_zero_mass_add_perturbation
    (hmodel : Integrable
      (fun x => energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hpert : Integrable
      (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x - 1) (b x) 0 (U x) (V x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) c U V +
        energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => a x - 1) b (fun _ => 0) U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_one_zero_zero
decls.doc:
The integrated `−Δ` model form is the integral of the dot product of the two gradient
components of the jet fields.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_one_zero_zero :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) U V =
      ∫ x, ((V x).2 ⬝ᵥ (U x).2) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass
decls.doc:
The integrated shifted Laplacian model form `−Δ + c` is the sum of the Dirichlet density
and the mass density.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass (m : X → ℝ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) m U V =
      ∫ x, ((V x).2 ⬝ᵥ (U x).2 + m x * (U x).1 * (V x).1) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self
decls.doc:
The diagonal of the integrated shifted Laplacian model is the integral of
`‖∇u‖² + c u²` at the jet level.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self (m : X → ℝ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) m U U =
      ∫ x, (‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 + m x * (U x).1 ^ 2) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.norm_energyFormIntegral_le_of_bounds
decls.doc:
Integrated boundedness of the raw-jet energy form from a.e. coefficient bounds.

This is the scalar integral version of `norm_energyIntegrand_apply_le_of_bounds`: if the
pointwise jet product `‖U x‖ * ‖V x‖` is integrable, the absolute value of the integrated form
is bounded by `(Λ + β + γ)` times its integral.
decls.statement:
lemma norm_energyFormIntegral_le_of_bounds (hLam : 0 ≤ Lam)
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ η ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      |η ⬝ᵥ (a x *ᵥ ξ)| ≤ Lam * ‖η‖ * ‖ξ‖)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖b x‖ ≤ beta) (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖c x‖ ≤ gamma)
    (hUV : Integrable (fun x => (Lam + beta + gamma) * (‖U x‖ * ‖V x‖)) μ) :
    ‖energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V‖ ≤
      ∫ x, ((Lam + beta + gamma) * (‖U x‖ * ‖V x‖)) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.garding_energyFormIntegral_self_of_bounds
decls.doc:
Integrated Gårding lower bound from a.e. lower ellipticity and a.e. lower-order
coefficient hypotheses.
decls.statement:
lemma garding_energyFormIntegral_self_of_bounds (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ξ ⬝ᵥ (a x *ᵥ ξ))
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖b x‖ ≤ beta) (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ c x)
    (hlower : Integrable
      (fun x => lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) * (U x).1 ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) * (U x).1 ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ a b c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.garding_energyFormIntegral_self_of_mass_lower_bound_of_bounds
decls.doc:
Integrated Gårding lower bound with a mass floor from a.e. lower ellipticity and a.e.
lower-order coefficient hypotheses.
decls.statement:
lemma garding_energyFormIntegral_self_of_mass_lower_bound_of_bounds (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ξ ⬝ᵥ (a x *ᵥ ξ))
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖b x‖ ≤ beta) (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, mu ≤ c x)
    (hlower : Integrable
      (fun x => lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 +
        (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * (U x).1 ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 +
        (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * (U x).1 ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ a b c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integral_min_lam_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_self
decls.doc:
Integrated zero-drift diagonal lower bound from an a.e. principal quadratic lower bound
and a.e. nonnegative mass coefficient.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_min_lam_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_self
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ξ ⬝ᵥ (a x *ᵥ ξ))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ c x)
    (hlower : Integrable (fun x => min lam (c x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 (c x) (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (min lam (c x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_self_nonneg
decls.doc:
A zero-drift diagonal integrated energy form is nonnegative when the principal quadratic
form and mass coefficient are a.e. nonnegative.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_self_nonneg
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n, 0 ≤ ξ ⬝ᵥ (a x *ᵥ ξ))
    (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ c x) :
    0 ≤ energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integral_min_diagonal_lower_bound_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_self_of_bounds
decls.doc:
Integrated explicit diagonal lower bound from a.e. lower ellipticity, a.e.
lower-order coefficient hypotheses, and a mass floor that dominates the drift defect.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_min_diagonal_lower_bound_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_self_of_bounds
    (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      lam * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ξ ⬝ᵥ (a x *ᵥ ξ))
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖b x‖ ≤ beta) (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, mu ≤ c x)
    (hmu : beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) ≤ mu)
    (hlower : Integrable
      (fun x => min (lam / 2) (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (min (lam / 2) (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ a b c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.UniformlyEllipticOn.norm_energyFormIntegral_le_on
decls.doc:
Integrated boundedness of the energy form from uniform ellipticity and a.e. lower-order
coefficient bounds.
decls.statement:
lemma norm_energyFormIntegral_le_on (h : UniformlyEllipticOn Ω a lam Lam)
    (hΩ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ω) (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖b x‖ ≤ beta)

      ∫ x, ((Lam + beta + gamma) * (‖U x‖ * ‖V x‖)) ∂μ

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.UniformlyEllipticOn.garding_energyFormIntegral_self_on
decls.doc:
Integrated Gårding lower bound from uniform ellipticity and a.e. lower-order

decls.statement:
lemma garding_energyFormIntegral_self_on (h : UniformlyEllipticOn Ω a lam Lam)

    (hlower : Integrable
      (fun x => lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) * (U x).1 ^ 2) μ)

decls.doc:
Integrated Gårding lower bound with a mass floor from uniform ellipticity and a.e.

decls.statement:
lemma garding_energyFormIntegral_self_of_mass_lower_bound_on
    (h : UniformlyEllipticOn Ω a lam Lam) (hΩ : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ω)

decls.doc:
Integrated explicit diagonal lower bound from uniform ellipticity, a.e.

lemma integral_min_diagonal_lower_bound_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_self_on

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_transpose_apply
decls.doc:
With zero drift, transposing the principal coefficient swaps the two jet fields under the
integral.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_transpose_apply :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => (a x)ᵀ) (fun _ => 0) c U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_comm_of_isSymm_ae
decls.doc:
A.e. symmetric principal coefficients make the zero-drift integrated energy form
symmetric.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_comm_of_isSymm_ae
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (a x).IsSymm) :
    energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c V U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_swap_eq_of_isSymm_ae
decls.doc:
Bundled-map form of symmetry for a zero-drift integrated energy form with a.e. symmetric
principal coefficients.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_swap_eq_of_isSymm_ae
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (a x).IsSymm) :
    Function.swap (energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c) =
      energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c

decls.doc:
Symmetry on a domain when the measure is a.e. supported there and the principal
coefficients are pointwise symmetric on that domain.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_zero_drift_comm_on {Ω : Set X}

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_comm
decls.doc: The shifted-Laplacian model integrated form `-Δ + c` is symmetric.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_comm :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) c U V =

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_coefficientSymmetricPart_self
decls.doc:
Replacing the principal coefficient by its symmetric part does not change the diagonal
integrated energy.  The drift and mass coefficients are arbitrary, since the diagonal
principal quadratic form is unchanged pointwise.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_coefficientSymmetricPart_self {b : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ n} :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x)) b c U U =
      energyFormIntegral μ a b c U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_apply
decls.doc:
The symmetric-part zero-drift integrated form is the average of the original zero-drift
form and its transpose, assuming the two original scalar densities are integrable.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_coefficientSymmetricPart_zero_drift_apply
    (hUV : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 (c x) (U x) (V x)) μ)
    (hVU : Integrable (fun x => energyIntegrand (a x) 0 (c x) (V x) (U x)) μ) :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x)) (fun _ => 0) c U V =
      (energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c U V +
        energyFormIntegral μ a (fun _ => 0) c V U) / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_coefficientSymmetricPart_eq_of_isSymm_ae
decls.doc:
For symmetric principal coefficients, replacing by the symmetric part leaves the integrated
form unchanged.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_coefficientSymmetricPart_eq_of_isSymm_ae {b : X → EuclideanSpace ℝ n}
    (ha : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (a x).IsSymm) :
    energyFormIntegral μ (fun x => coefficientSymmetricPart (a x)) b c U V =
      energyFormIntegral μ a b c U V

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integral_min_one_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self
decls.doc:
Integrated diagonal lower bound for the shifted-Laplacian model with variable
nonnegative mass.

Pointwise, `energyIntegrand 1 0 (m x) (U x) (U x)` is
`‖(U x).2‖² + m x * (U x).1²`, so for `m x ≥ 0` it controls the full product jet norm
with coefficient `min 1 (m x)`.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_min_one_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self
    (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ m x)
    (hlower : Integrable (fun x => min 1 (m x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable
      (fun x => energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 (m x) (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (min 1 (m x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) m U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self_nonneg
decls.doc: The shifted-Laplacian diagonal form is nonnegative when the mass is a.e. nonnegative.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self_nonneg
    (hm : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ m x) :
    0 ≤ energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) m U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_one_zero_zero_self_nonneg
decls.doc: The Dirichlet model `-Δ` has nonnegative diagonal energy.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_one_zero_zero_self_nonneg :
    0 ≤ energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integral_min_one_const_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self
decls.doc: Constant-mass specialization of the integrated shifted-Laplacian lower bound.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_min_one_const_mass_mul_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hlower : Integrable (fun x => min 1 c * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable
      (fun x => energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (min 1 c * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => c) U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.energyFormIntegral_one_zero_const_mass_self_nonneg
decls.doc: Constant nonnegative mass gives a nonnegative shifted-Laplacian diagonal form.
decls.statement:
lemma energyFormIntegral_one_zero_const_mass_self_nonneg {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    0 ≤ energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => c) U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integral_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self_of_one_le
decls.doc:
If the constant mass is at least `1`, the shifted-Laplacian diagonal form controls the
full raw jet `L²` density with constant `1`.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_mass_self_of_one_le
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hlower : Integrable (fun x => ‖U x‖ ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable
      (fun x => energyIntegrand (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) 0 c (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (‖U x‖ ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ (fun _ => (1 : Matrix n n ℝ)) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => c) U U

decls.name: TauCeti.PDE.integral_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_one_self
decls.doc:
For constant mass `1`, the shifted-Laplacian diagonal form controls the full raw jet
`L²` density with constant `1`.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_norm_sq_le_energyFormIntegral_one_zero_one_self
