decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevCosineL2Equiv
decls.doc:
**The Chebyshev-to-cosine `L²` equivalence.** It pulls a function on `[-1,1]` back along
`x = cos θ`; its inverse pulls an angular function back along `θ = arccos x`.
decls.title: The Chebyshev-to-cosine `L²` equivalence
decls.statement:
def chebyshevCosineL2Equiv :
    Lp 𝕜 2 measureT ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] Lp 𝕜 2 chebyshevAngleMeasure

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevCosineL2Equiv_apply
decls.doc: The forward Chebyshev-to-cosine equivalence is composition with `Real.cos`.
decls.statement:
theorem chebyshevCosineL2Equiv_apply (f : Lp 𝕜 2 measureT) :
    ⇑(chebyshevCosineL2Equiv 𝕜 f) =ᵐ[chebyshevAngleMeasure] fun θ => f (Real.cos θ)

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevCosineL2Equiv_symm_apply
decls.doc: The inverse Chebyshev-to-cosine equivalence is composition with `Real.arccos`.
decls.statement:
theorem chebyshevCosineL2Equiv_symm_apply (f : Lp 𝕜 2 chebyshevAngleMeasure) :
    ⇑((chebyshevCosineL2Equiv 𝕜).symm f) =ᵐ[measureT] fun x => f (Real.arccos x)

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevCosine
decls.doc: The cosine-side representative corresponding to the Chebyshev polynomial `Tₙ`.
decls.statement: def chebyshevCosine (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevCosine_def
decls.doc: The defining equation for the cosine-side Chebyshev representative.
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevCosine_def (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) : chebyshevCosine n θ = Real.cos (n * θ)

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevCosine_zero
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevCosine_zero (θ : ℝ) : chebyshevCosine 0 θ = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevCosine_one
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevCosine_one (θ : ℝ) : chebyshevCosine 1 θ = Real.cos θ

decls.name: TauCeti.eval_T_real_cos_eq_chebyshevCosine
decls.doc: Chebyshev polynomials restrict along `x = cos θ` to the cosine functions.
decls.statement:
lemma eval_T_real_cos_eq_chebyshevCosine (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (T ℝ n).eval (Real.cos θ) = chebyshevCosine n θ

decls.name: TauCeti.continuous_chebyshevCosine
decls.doc: The cosine-side representatives are continuous.
decls.statement: lemma continuous_chebyshevCosine (n : ℕ) : Continuous (chebyshevCosine n)

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_eval_T_real_measureT_eq_integral_chebyshevCosine
decls.doc:
Transfer a single Chebyshev `T` integral from `measureT` to the angular
cosine-side integral.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_eval_T_real_measureT_eq_integral_chebyshevCosine (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (T ℝ n).eval x ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT =
      ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, chebyshevCosine n θ

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_eq_integral_chebyshevCosine_mul
decls.doc:
Transfer a product of two Chebyshev `T` polynomials from `measureT` to the
angular cosine-side integral.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_eq_integral_chebyshevCosine_mul
    (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (T ℝ m).eval x * (T ℝ n).eval x ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT =
      ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, chebyshevCosine m θ * chebyshevCosine n θ

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_chebyshevCosine_zero
decls.doc: The cosine-side integral of the constant Chebyshev mode.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_chebyshevCosine_zero :
    ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, chebyshevCosine 0 θ = Real.pi

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_chebyshevCosine_of_ne_zero
decls.doc: Nonzero cosine modes have zero integral over `[0, π]`.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_chebyshevCosine_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, chebyshevCosine n θ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_chebyshevCosine_mul_self
decls.doc:
The diagonal cosine-side `L²` integral, using the same squared-norm
constant as the Chebyshev `T` polynomials.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_chebyshevCosine_mul_self (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, chebyshevCosine n θ * chebyshevCosine n θ =
      chebyshevTNormSq n

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_chebyshevCosine_mul_chebyshevCosine_of_ne
decls.doc: Off-diagonal cosine modes are orthogonal over `[0, π]`.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_chebyshevCosine_mul_chebyshevCosine_of_ne {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≠ n) :
    ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, chebyshevCosine m θ * chebyshevCosine n θ = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_chebyshevCosine_mul_chebyshevCosine_eq_ite
decls.doc:
Cosine-side Chebyshev orthogonality in the Kronecker-delta form expected by
the later Chebyshev Hilbert-basis construction.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_chebyshevCosine_mul_chebyshevCosine_eq_ite (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, chebyshevCosine m θ * chebyshevCosine n θ =
      if m = n then chebyshevTNormSq n else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevCosine
decls.doc: The normalized angular cosine mode corresponding to the normalized Chebyshev `Tₙ` mode.
decls.statement: def normalizedChebyshevCosine (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevCosine_def
decls.doc: The defining equation for the normalized angular cosine representative.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizedChebyshevCosine_def (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    normalizedChebyshevCosine n θ =
      chebyshevCosine n θ / Real.sqrt (chebyshevTNormSq n)

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevCosine_zero
decls.statement:
lemma normalizedChebyshevCosine_zero (θ : ℝ) :
    normalizedChebyshevCosine 0 θ = 1 / Real.sqrt Real.pi

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevCosine_one
decls.statement:
lemma normalizedChebyshevCosine_one (θ : ℝ) :
    normalizedChebyshevCosine 1 θ = Real.cos θ / Real.sqrt (Real.pi / 2)

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevCosine_of_ne_zero
decls.statement:
lemma normalizedChebyshevCosine_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (θ : ℝ) :
    normalizedChebyshevCosine n θ = Real.cos (n * θ) / Real.sqrt (Real.pi / 2)

decls.name: TauCeti.continuous_normalizedChebyshevCosine
decls.doc: The normalized angular Chebyshev representatives are continuous.
decls.statement:
lemma continuous_normalizedChebyshevCosine (n : ℕ) :
    Continuous (normalizedChebyshevCosine n)

decls.name: TauCeti.normalized_eval_T_real_cos_eq_normalizedChebyshevCosine
decls.doc:
Pulling back a normalized Chebyshev `T` polynomial along `x = cos θ` gives the normalized
angular cosine mode.
decls.statement:
lemma normalized_eval_T_real_cos_eq_normalizedChebyshevCosine (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (T ℝ n).eval (Real.cos θ) / Real.sqrt (chebyshevTNormSq n) =
      normalizedChebyshevCosine n θ

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_normalized_eval_T_real_mul_measureT_eq_integral_normalizedChebyshevCosine_mul
decls.doc:
Transfer a product of normalized Chebyshev `T` polynomials from `measureT` to the normalized
angular cosine-side integral.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_normalized_eval_T_real_mul_measureT_eq_integral_normalizedChebyshevCosine_mul
    (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, ((T ℝ m).eval x / Real.sqrt (chebyshevTNormSq m)) *
        ((T ℝ n).eval x / Real.sqrt (chebyshevTNormSq n)) ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT =
      ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, normalizedChebyshevCosine m θ *
        normalizedChebyshevCosine n θ

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_normalizedChebyshevCosine_mul_self
decls.doc: The diagonal normalized angular cosine modes have integral one over `[0, π]`.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_normalizedChebyshevCosine_mul_self (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, normalizedChebyshevCosine n θ * normalizedChebyshevCosine n θ = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_normalizedChebyshevCosine_mul_normalizedChebyshevCosine_of_ne
decls.doc: Distinct normalized angular cosine modes are orthogonal over `[0, π]`.

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_normalizedChebyshevCosine_mul_normalizedChebyshevCosine_eq_ite
decls.doc: Normalized angular Chebyshev-cosine orthogonality in Kronecker-delta form.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_normalizedChebyshevCosine_mul_normalizedChebyshevCosine_eq_ite (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫ θ in (0)..Real.pi, normalizedChebyshevCosine m θ * normalizedChebyshevCosine n θ =
      if m = n then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.monomial_moment_measureT_eq_zero
decls.doc:
**Monomial-orthogonality from mode-orthogonality.** A vector of `L²(measureT)` orthogonal to
every normalized Chebyshev mode has every scalar-cast monomial moment `∫ (x : 𝕜)ⁿ · g` vanishing.
This threads `inner_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_eq_zero` (orthogonality to every polynomial
evaluation) through the `L²` inner product at `q = Xⁿ`.
decls.title: Monomial-orthogonality from mode-orthogonality
decls.statement:
theorem monomial_moment_measureT_eq_zero (g : Lp 𝕜 2 measureT)
    (hmode : ∀ n, inner 𝕜 g (normalizedChebyshevTLp 𝕜 n) = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 x) ^ n * g x ∂measureT = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.orthogonal_span_normalizedChebyshevTLp_eq_bot
decls.doc:
**Completeness of the Chebyshev family.** The orthogonal complement of the span of the
normalized modes is trivial: a vector orthogonal to all of them has vanishing monomial moments and
is therefore a.e. `0` by moment determinacy.
decls.title: Completeness of the Chebyshev family
decls.statement:
theorem orthogonal_span_normalizedChebyshevTLp_eq_bot :
    (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (normalizedChebyshevTLp 𝕜)))ᗮ = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevTHilbertBasis
decls.doc:
**Roadmap Part C: the Chebyshev `T` polynomials are a Hilbert basis of `L²(measureT)`.**
Orthonormality is `orthonormal_normalizedChebyshevTLp`; completeness is
`orthogonal_span_normalizedChebyshevTLp_eq_bot`, which is where the shipped Chebyshev groundwork had
stopped, one step short of the function-level moment-determinacy theorem.
decls.title: Roadmap Part C: the Chebyshev `T` polynomials are a Hilbert basis of `L²(measureT)`
decls.statement: def chebyshevTHilbertBasis : HilbertBasis ℕ 𝕜 (Lp 𝕜 2 measureT)

decls.name: TauCeti.coe_chebyshevTHilbertBasis
decls.doc:
**The basis vectors are the normalized Chebyshev modes.** Without this the construction would
only exhibit *some* Hilbert basis of `L²(measureT)`; here each vector is pinned to `Tₙ/√‖Tₙ‖²`.
decls.title: The basis vectors are the normalized Chebyshev modes
decls.statement:
theorem coe_chebyshevTHilbertBasis :
    ⇑(chebyshevTHilbertBasis 𝕜) = normalizedChebyshevTLp 𝕜

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevMeasureT_univ
decls.doc: The Chebyshev `T` orthogonality measure has total mass `π`.
decls.statement:
lemma chebyshevMeasureT_univ :
    Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT Set.univ = ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevMeasureT.instIsFiniteMeasure
decls.doc: Mathlib's Chebyshev `T` orthogonality measure is finite.
decls.statement:
instance chebyshevMeasureT.instIsFiniteMeasure :
    IsFiniteMeasure Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevMeasureT_univ_pos
decls.doc: The Chebyshev `T` orthogonality measure has positive total mass.
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevMeasureT_univ_pos : 0 < Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT Set.univ

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevMeasureT_ne_zero
decls.doc: Mathlib's Chebyshev `T` orthogonality measure is nonzero.
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevMeasureT_ne_zero : Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevTNormSq
decls.doc: The squared `L²(measureT)` norm of the `n`th Chebyshev `T` polynomial.
decls.statement: def chebyshevTNormSq (n : ℕ) : ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevTNormSq_zero
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevTNormSq_zero : chebyshevTNormSq 0 = Real.pi

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevTNormSq_of_ne_zero
decls.statement:
lemma chebyshevTNormSq_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    chebyshevTNormSq n = Real.pi / 2

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevTNormSq_pos
decls.doc: The squared norm constant for Chebyshev `T` polynomials is positive.
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevTNormSq_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < chebyshevTNormSq n

decls.name: TauCeti.chebyshevTNormSq_ne_zero
decls.doc: The squared norm constant for Chebyshev `T` polynomials is nonzero.
decls.statement: lemma chebyshevTNormSq_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : chebyshevTNormSq n ≠ 0

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_eval_T_real_mul_self_measureT
decls.doc:
The diagonal Chebyshev `T` orthogonality integral, with the degree-zero and
positive-degree cases hidden behind one normalization constant.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_eval_T_real_mul_self_measureT (n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (T ℝ n).eval x * (T ℝ n).eval x ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT =
      chebyshevTNormSq n

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_eq_ite
decls.doc:
Chebyshev `T` orthogonality in the Kronecker-delta form expected by the
general orthogonality-to-Hilbert-basis bridge.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_eval_T_real_mul_eval_T_real_measureT_eq_ite (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, (T ℝ m).eval x * (T ℝ n).eval x ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT =
      if m = n then chebyshevTNormSq n else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.ae_mem_Icc_measureT
decls.doc: The Chebyshev `T` orthogonality measure is supported on `[-1, 1]`.
decls.statement:
lemma ae_mem_Icc_measureT :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT, x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

decls.name: TauCeti.integrable_exp_mul_abs_smul_measureT
decls.doc:
Multiplication by an exponential absolute moment preserves `L¹(measureT)`.

This is the compact-support consumer form used by the Chebyshev completeness
argument.
decls.statement:
lemma integrable_exp_mul_abs_smul_measureT {𝕜 β : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup β]
    [NormedSpace 𝕜 β] {g : ℝ → β} (a : ℝ)
    (hg : Integrable g Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (Real.exp (a * |x|) : 𝕜) • g x)
      Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevT
decls.doc: The real normalized Chebyshev `T` mode, with squared norm one in `L²(measureT)`.
decls.statement: def normalizedChebyshevT (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevT_def
decls.doc: The defining equation for the real normalized Chebyshev `T` mode.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizedChebyshevT_def (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    normalizedChebyshevT n x = (T ℝ n).eval x / Real.sqrt (chebyshevTNormSq n)

decls.name: TauCeti.continuous_normalizedChebyshevT
decls.doc: The real normalized Chebyshev `T` mode is continuous.
decls.statement:
lemma continuous_normalizedChebyshevT (n : ℕ) :
    Continuous (normalizedChebyshevT n)

decls.doc: The real normalized Chebyshev `T` mode lies in `L²(measureT)`.
decls.statement:
lemma memLp_normalizedChebyshevT_measureT (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (normalizedChebyshevT n) 2 Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT

decls.name: TauCeti.memLp_algebraMap_normalizedChebyshevT_measureT
decls.doc:
The scalar-cast normalized Chebyshev `T` mode lies in `L²(measureT)`, in
the form consumed by the family-generic orthogonality-to-Hilbert-basis bridge.
decls.statement:
lemma memLp_algebraMap_normalizedChebyshevT_measureT {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (n : ℕ) :
    MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (normalizedChebyshevT n x)) 2

decls.name: TauCeti.normalizedChebyshevTLp
decls.doc: The normalized Chebyshev `T` mode as a vector of `L²(measureT)`.
decls.statement:
def normalizedChebyshevTLp (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (n : ℕ) :
    Lp 𝕜 2 Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT

decls.name: TauCeti.coeFn_normalizedChebyshevTLp
decls.doc:
The `Lp` representative of the normalized Chebyshev `T` mode is the expected scalar-cast
function.
decls.statement:
lemma coeFn_normalizedChebyshevTLp {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (n : ℕ) :
    ⇑(normalizedChebyshevTLp 𝕜 n) =ᵐ[Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT]
      fun x : ℝ => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (normalizedChebyshevT n x)

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_normalizedChebyshevT_mul_normalizedChebyshevT_measureT_eq_ite
decls.doc:
The real `measureT` integral of two normalized Chebyshev `T` modes is the Kronecker
delta.
decls.statement:
lemma integral_normalizedChebyshevT_mul_normalizedChebyshevT_measureT_eq_ite (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫ x, normalizedChebyshevT m x * normalizedChebyshevT n x
        ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT = if m = n then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.inner_normalizedChebyshevTLp
decls.doc: The normalized Chebyshev `T` modes have Kronecker-delta inner products in `L²(measureT)`.
decls.statement:
lemma inner_normalizedChebyshevTLp {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (m n : ℕ) :

decls.name: TauCeti.inner_normalizedChebyshevTLp_real
decls.doc:
The normalized Chebyshev `T` modes have Kronecker-delta inner products in real
`L²(measureT)`.
decls.statement:
lemma inner_normalizedChebyshevTLp_real (m n : ℕ) :
    inner ℝ (normalizedChebyshevTLp ℝ m) (normalizedChebyshevTLp ℝ n) =
      if m = n then 1 else 0

decls.name: TauCeti.orthonormal_normalizedChebyshevTLp
decls.doc: The normalized Chebyshev `T` modes form an orthonormal family in `L²(measureT)`.
decls.statement:
lemma orthonormal_normalizedChebyshevTLp {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] :

decls.name: TauCeti.orthonormal_normalizedChebyshevTLp_real
decls.doc: The normalized Chebyshev `T` modes form an orthonormal family in real `L²(measureT)`.
decls.statement:
lemma orthonormal_normalizedChebyshevTLp_real :
    Orthonormal ℝ (normalizedChebyshevTLp ℝ)

decls.doc:
A real polynomial evaluation, cast to any `RCLike` scalar field, lies in `L²` with respect

lemma memLp_two_algebraMap_eval_measureT {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] (q : Polynomial ℝ) :

decls.name: TauCeti.polynomialEvalChebyshevLp
decls.doc:
Evaluate a real polynomial and, casting into any `[RCLike 𝕜]` scalar field, regard the result
as an element of `L²(Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT)`.

The map is well-defined because every polynomial has finite second moment for the Chebyshev
measure.
decls.statement:
def polynomialEvalChebyshevLp (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] :
    Polynomial ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] Lp 𝕜 2 Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT

decls.name: TauCeti.coeFn_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp
decls.doc:
The `L²` representative of a polynomial evaluation is the expected scalar-cast pointwise
evaluation.
decls.statement:
lemma coeFn_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ⇑(polynomialEvalChebyshevLp 𝕜 q) =ᵐ[Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT]
      fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (q.eval x)

decls.name: TauCeti.polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_T
decls.doc:
Under the polynomial-evaluation map, the `n`th Chebyshev polynomial is the square root of its
squared norm times the normalized `n`th Chebyshev mode.
decls.statement:
lemma polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_T (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (n : ℕ) :
    polynomialEvalChebyshevLp 𝕜 (T ℝ n) =
      Real.sqrt (chebyshevTNormSq n) • normalizedChebyshevTLp 𝕜 n

decls.name: TauCeti.polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_mem_span
decls.doc:
Every real polynomial evaluation in `L²(measureT)` belongs to the linear span of the
normalized Chebyshev modes.
decls.statement:
theorem polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_mem_span (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    polynomialEvalChebyshevLp 𝕜 q ∈
      Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (normalizedChebyshevTLp 𝕜))

decls.name: TauCeti.inner_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_eq_zero
decls.doc:
A vector orthogonal to every normalized Chebyshev mode is orthogonal to the `L²` evaluation
of every real polynomial.

This is the abstract form used in the Chebyshev completeness argument: the algebraic Chebyshev
basis converts the mode hypotheses into orthogonality against every polynomial evaluation.
decls.statement:
theorem inner_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_eq_zero (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜]
    (g : Lp 𝕜 2 Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT)
    (hmode : ∀ n, inner 𝕜 g (normalizedChebyshevTLp 𝕜 n) = 0) (q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    inner 𝕜 g (polynomialEvalChebyshevLp 𝕜 q) = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.inner_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp
decls.doc:
The inner product of a vector with a polynomial evaluation is the corresponding polynomial
moment against the Chebyshev measure.
decls.statement:
lemma inner_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp (g : Lp ℝ 2 Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT)
    (q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    inner ℝ g (polynomialEvalChebyshevLp ℝ q) =
      ∫ x, g x * q.eval x ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT

decls.name: TauCeti.integral_polynomialEval_measureT_eq_zero
decls.doc:
A vector orthogonal to every normalized Chebyshev mode has vanishing polynomial moments: this
is the concrete integral form of `inner_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_eq_zero`.
decls.statement:
theorem integral_polynomialEval_measureT_eq_zero
    (g : Lp ℝ 2 Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT)
    (hmode : ∀ n, inner ℝ g (normalizedChebyshevTLp ℝ n) = 0) (q : Polynomial ℝ) :
    ∫ x, g x * q.eval x ∂Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT = 0
